notes: 25 candidates: 5 program-list, 0 single-record, 20 not-a-list. The two Lausanne past-theses URLs (with and without /en/) are the same page; the capture text shows only the 2019 and 2018 tabs, so earlier years (2006-2017) would need the live page or other captures. The Lausanne placements page gives current positions of former doctoral students in testimonials, not dated first jobs, and covers the whole PhD in Management (marketing, OB, strategy, finance, accounting as well as operations); the area must be classified per person. The Illinois ISE dissertation table is an engineering department (industrial and systems engineering, in scope) and gives advisors and terms but no placements. The Iowa Business Analytics page names a single 2019 job-market candidate. The Kansas PhD alumni landing page has no names but links to per-discipline rosters, including Decision Sciences and Supply Chain Management, which are worth fetching separately. Institutions by host were kept for every page.
